Each reconstructs fixed references and compares against hash-bound own CPU uniform or combined. Audit failure or missing coverage prevents the formal freeze; preserve all capture and score rows. Qualification overlap supplies no timing evidence.

formal_timing.stock_windows: One mid25 and one high55 prospective window. All timed workers use the same qualified policy, minimal imports, warp observer, affinity and monitoring. Preserve the 720s active cap and original quiet policy. Missing or interrupted windows remain diagnostic.
formal_timing.conditional_factorial: 160 slots, only if both engines independently pass exact T72 in a symmetrical runtime. Same 5 blocks include both engines per method/schedule and per FD baseline; engine and schedule effects and their interaction can be estimated on Galerkin pairs. An expanded window plan must be independently registered before any timings. If keeping the 720s cap, partition high by whole blocks, e.g. 3+2, keeping each engine pair in the same window.
formal_timing.clocks: Keep separate complete solver and Popen-to-flushed-RETURN clocks, including all declared preparation, runtime work and teardown. Serialize after SAVE. Maintain exact owned terminal accounting, independent verifier and existing five-pair/1.05 practical rule on both clocks.
